title: Making every stage of medical device document assessment with large language models deterministic
abstract: arXiv:2610.21300v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: To show that a medical device complies with regulation, experts judge whether documents and records meet each requirement and record the judgment for others to verify. For each assessment item that experts define, large language models could prepare a preliminary assessment: a label such as Satisfied or Not satisfied, a reason and quoted evidence. We sent fourteen commercial deployments of such models (seven models from three providers, through six routes) the same request repeatedly, with the deterministic sampling settings each accepted; every deployment returned differing assessments for at least one request, and in twelve the label changed. Reducing reasoning where the interface allows it did not reduce the variation, and prompts of retrieved passages removed it only for the smallest models. The same open-weight model was reproducible or not depending only on how it was served. A pipeline we built to be deterministic at every stage -

translated_title: 利用大语言模型使医疗设备文档评估的每个阶段都具备确定性
translated_abstract: 为了证明医疗设备符合法规要求，专家需要判断文档和记录是否满足每一项要求，并将判断结果记录下来供他人核查。对于专家定义的每个评估项目，大语言模型可以准备一份初步评估：诸如“满足”或“不满足”的标签、理由以及引用的证据。我们向十四个此类模型的商业部署（来自三家供应商的七个模型，通过六种途径）重复发送相同的请求，并使用各自接受的确定性采样设置；每个部署至少对一个请求返回了不同的评估结果，其中十二个部署的标签发生了变化。在接口允许的情况下减少推理并不能减少这种变化，而使用检索段落的提示仅对最小的模型消除了这种变化。同一个开放权重模型是否可复现，仅取决于其部署服务的方式。我们构建的一个在每个阶段都确定性的流水线——
tldr: 研究发现十四个大语言模型商业部署在确定性采样设置下仍无法对医疗设备文档评估给出一致结果，作者据此构建了一个在每个阶段都具备确定性的评估流水线。
en_tdlr: Fourteen commercial LLM deployments fail to produce consistent medical device document assessments even under deterministic sampling settings, and the authors built a pipeline designed to be deterministic at every stage.
